draft.text:
{"letter":"Dear Priya Raman,

A marketing job built around an email newsletter and two paddle festivals a year sounds like a great mix of writing and logistics, and that's the work I've done for the past five years. I'd love to bring it to Harpeth Outdoor Co. as your Marketing Coordinator.

At Harpeth Valley Rec Center, I wrote the weekly member newsletter for 3,000 subscribers. Running your newsletter would be a familiar rhythm for me: a list of a few thousand people who actually want to hear from you, and a deadline that comes around every week. I also coordinated volunteer schedules for 25 community events a year there. When you're putting on that many events, the volunteers are a big part of what makes each one work, and I expect your spring and fall festivals rely on them just as much.

Since 2021 I've been the Social Media Manager for Riverbend Youth Soccer League. The biggest event I've taken on there was a 40-team spring tournament with 600 attendees, which I planned and ran from start to finish. On the social side, I grew our Instagram following from 2,400 to 9,100 in two seasons. I also cut our paid ad spend by 38% by moving that budget to player-made video. I do most of my design work in Canva, so I'd be comfortable jumping into your graphics and helping keep your posts looking consistent from week to week.

Most of my events so far have happened on soccer fields, and I'd happily trade the sideline for a riverbank. A company that sells canoes and gets people out on the water for a festival every spring and fall is easy to write about, and I'd enjoy telling your community what's coming up next.

I'd love to hear what you have planned for this year's festivals and talk about how I could help.

Thanks for your time,
Jordan Avery"}
